name: HatchGrab
subtitle: Food truck orders, kitchen
promotionalText: Take pre-orders, protect the kitchen from too many orders and carry on with service even if the connection is cut. The app for food truck staff.
description:
HatchGrab is the ordering and kitchen app for food truck businesses: the tool your team runs service with.

Customers order ahead and choose a collection time. Your staff see every order on one screen, confirm what the kitchen can cook, then mark the order “Ready” and “Collected”.

■ Don’t give a promise for a time you can’t meet
Set how much your kitchen can cook at the same time and how long it takes. Once a collection time is full, customers can’t choose it; so the queue matches the kitchen’s pace.

■ Take orders right at the food truck
Add walk-up orders too, on the same screen where pre-orders come in; so the kitchen works from one queue.

■ One screen for the kitchen
The kitchen screen (KDS) shows what needs making now, what comes next and what is ready; it also gives an alert when an order needs starting.

■ Print order tickets
Connect the kitchen receipt printer via Bluetooth or via your local network; order tickets print automatically.

■ Carry on with service even if the connection is cut
Switch on offline protection: if the connection is cut, pre-orders pause; so nobody can place an order you don’t see. Orders you take on the device are saved and sync once the connection is back.

■ Made just for the food truck vehicle
Use it on an iPhone or iPad device. Keep the screen on during service, get a notification when an order needs confirming, and lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID.

■ Plan your week
Set up your events and locations once, and take orders for each one.

HatchGrab is for food truck owners and their staff. You need a HatchGrab account to sign in.
